# Emblem: the sun disc over the temple gate (a 12-sided disc with two wing slabs), facing the court.
# Baked twice: dark stone, and glowing when a puzzle is solved. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Disc --base-color 0.4196 0.1373 0.2549 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Disc --vertices 12 --radius 0.42 --depth 0.14 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name WingL --size 1 --location -0.750 0.000 0.060
scale 0.750 0.100 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name WingR --size 1 --location 0.750 0.000 0.060
scale 0.750 0.100 0.200
apply --scale
select Disc WingL WingR
active Disc
join
material assign Disc
shade flat
export emblem.glb
